# Phase 3 tables (generated by experiments/phase3/3g_tables.py from results/phase3/*.json)

Units: a = c = 1, f = a/lambda; per-period delay tau_pp = n_g in a/c; GDD per period in (a/c)^2. FDTD columns are production runs (res 30, decay_tol = 1e-7, N = 4, 8, 12, plain-W1 leads, reference planes 3 periods outside the device). 'validated' = restricted to 0.231-0.268 (Phase 2 validation limit, upper edge chosen post hoc in Phase 2).

Leads: plain W1 (f1 = 1, s = 0). Device section: rows |j| = 1 with radius f1 r, shifted by s (negative = toward the defect). Source: Hz line source shaped by the plain-W1 forward mode (f = 0.2475, fwidth 0.25).

## T2. MPB (res 32, M = 6, nk = 101; Hz-even band 8)

| design | band edge (min f) | band top | n_g,min (at f) | min gap to even band 7 / 9 | k-grid (51-pt spline vs HF) max rel. n_g diff, 0.231-0.268 | res 48 vs 32, max rel. n_g diff in MPB +-10% band | res 48 vs 32, worst over 0.231-0.268 (at f) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| D0 | 0.2134 | 0.2830 | 3.87 (0.2564) | 0.0123 / 0.0064 | 4.0e-05 | n/a (D0: converged in Phase 2) | n/a |
| D1 | 0.2295 | 0.2883 | 3.99 (0.2777) | 0.0256 / 0.0017 | 3.5e-04 | 5.3e-04 | 2.6% (at 0.231) |
| D2 | 0.2368 | 0.2865 | 4.07 (0.2842) | 0.0322 / 0.0003 | 5.8e-04 | 7.1e-04 | 13.2% (at 0.237) |

Band identity of D1/D2: the engineered geometry is a continuous deformation of the plain W1 (same hole rows, only the rows |j| = 1 are modified); band 8 of the Hz-even class stays monotone decreasing over the retained branch and isolated from band 9 only narrowly (gap above); the identity was also confirmed by the FDTD: the measured Bloch phase per period tracks the MPB kappa of the same band (3-length fit rms <= 0.01 rad in the usable bands) and the FDTD transmission turns on at the MPB band edge. Confinement (strip energy) diagnostics were computed only for the plain W1 (Phase 2) and for R, not for D1/D2.

GBP = fractional bandwidth x median n_g (declared definition). Target delay = 25 carrier cycles at the band center (criteria Revision 3). Band ends are limited by the 0.268 validated-range edge, so these are lower bounds of what the same rule gives without the restriction (T4).

R carries no FDTD validation, no interface/transmission information and a coarser MPB (res 24, nk 61). Its retained branch was cut at f < 0.42 by the 3a band selection (its single-mode gap extends to ~0.43), so the +-10% band touches the retained upper limit (0.4193) and R's fractional bandwidths here are lower bounds, not converged band widths. Compare with the MPB rows of T8 for D0-D2, not with the FDTD rows.
